title: A held frame on the timeline looks like the freeze mock's Still clip
goal: When you hold a frame, the timeline draws the held stretch as a dimmed copy of the clip with a tiny hold badge, and the canvas shows a snowflake. The freeze walkthrough draws it as its own kind of clip: blue diagonal stripes, a solid blue edge, and a label that says Still and how long it holds, with a pause sign on the canvas. Since gaps are now drawn as dashed grey stripes, the held stretch needs the mock's own look so a person can tell a still picture from a hole at a glance.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-freeze-wt.html lines 41-46 (still clip CSS and canvas badge), 111, 337 (the Still label). App: Sources/Photonz/ClipPiecesBar.swift:635-637, 699-705, 755 (40 percent black veil, layer name, hold corner badge); canvas badge Sources/Photonz/EditorView.swift:3452-3466 (snowflake on a glass capsule). hold-on-a-frame (done) left the hatch out on purpose ('a second visual language costs a lesson'); that predates the gap slot (9db4ed6b, TimelineGapSlot in TimelineLaneDrop.swift), which now gives stripes a meaning of their own, and mocks are the floor. Reuse the gap slot's stripe drawing (TimelineEmptySlot takes stripe width and tone) with the mock's blue tones. Found by the manager's mock sweep 2026-10-07.
acceptance: Hold a frame on the sample talk at Next defaults (right-click a clip, Freeze Frame, Freeze for 2 seconds): the held piece is drawn as video-freeze-wt.html draws it, 45 degree stripes in #3a4a7d and #2b3763, a #55689f edge, label text #dbe4ff reading a pause sign, Still and its length (for example Still · 0:02)
It never reads as a gap: side by side with a gap slot on the same track in one picture, in dark and light
The canvas badge for a held frame wears the mock's pause sign instead of the snowflake; its top right place stays (decided in hold-on-a-frame, the bottom carries the tool bar)
The held piece still picks, trims and deletes as it does today; an existing hold walk still passes, and a walk photographs the new look
